# netbox_circuit_group (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
// Get Circuit Group by Name
data "netbox_circuit_group" "example" {
    name = "GroupA"
}

// Get Circuit Group by ID
data "netbox_circuit_group" "example_by_id" {
    id = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) At least one of `id` or `name` must be given.
- `name` (String) At least one of `id` or `name` must be given.
